name: fastpay-monorepo
description: 1. Ushbu papkada `.env` faylini yarating va unga `.env.example` dagi ma'lumotlarni ko'chiring. 2. Ma'lumotlar bazasi (PostgreSQL) va Redis ni ishga tushirish uchun:    ```bash    docker-compose up -d    ``` 3. Backend (NestJS) uchun:    ```bash    cd backend    npm install    npx prisma db push    npm run start:dev    ``` 4. Frontend (React) uchun:    ```bash    cd frontend    npm install    npm run dev    ```
